messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency_slo.breach detected for service=runtime-api env=prod p95=420ms p99=1.8s > SLO thresholds. Auto-page to #eng-oncall. Incident severity: P1
ryan: I'm on it. seeing a sudden jump in p95 and p99 across us-east-1 GPU nodes. streaming stalls spike too. anyone oncall for infra?
maria: I can help with infra. initial graphs show sharp increase in disk paging i/o wait on a subset of hosts — looks like KV cache read amplification.
omar: log snippet from one host: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z WARN kv_cache: eviction storm triggered slab_frag=0.78 prefill_queue=2300 decode_queue=4000 page_faults=1430
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR runtime: stream stall detected seq=1245 duration=1.7s
```
ryan: thanks. customer-facing impact? any 502/stream resets?
jess: A few customers reported partial responses / long stalls on streaming endpoints, but not full 5xx flood. So degraded quality+latency, not complete outage. Support ticket count up ~12 in last 10m.
kevin: hypothesis: KV slabs fragmented after rapid prefill burst (large prefix reuse) — prefill allocs small chunks, decoder paths expect contiguous KV ranges, causing heavy page-in and software-level copying -> stalls at tail.
maria: agreed. our page-in metric (/proc/vmstat pgmajfaults) correlates with p99 start. where is the pressure concentrated?
omar: it's hot on shard 23 and 24 on the west pool, and on a few dedicated nodes in us-east-1a. Hot-shard imbalance + small slab sizes.
ryan: mitigation options: 1) throttle/disable prefill for high-rate models 2) increase slab consolidation (hotfix config) 3) route traffic off affected shards 4) fall back to smaller model variant for streaming until resolved. which is fastest?
jess: fastest is (1) throttle prefill per-model to 0.2x for models with >200 rps. Can push config flag from runtime-config service. I'll prepare change.
kevin: also rolling restart of affected worker processes will free fragmented slabs quickly but will drop in-flight KV caches and cause warmup latency — tradeoff.
maria: routing traffic away from affected nodes via autoscaler or weight adjustment is safe. we can reduce load on shards 23/24 by shifting to spare pool. infra-bot: Created allocation plan: move 30% traffic off us-east-1a-spare -> start now.
infra-bot: ACTION: started reweighting: shards 23,24 -> decr weight by 0.3; spare-pool -> incr weight by 0.3. ETA 90s.
omar: also enabling `kv.prefill.disabled=true` for model-family=redwood-13b across prod might stop new prefill allocations. Jess, can you roll that?
jess: pushing config now: `curl -XPOST https://runtime-config/api/flags -d '{"kv.prefill.disabled":true, "scope":"redwood-13b"}'`
jess: done. monitoring metrics... prefill queue size starting to drop. prefill_queue from 2300 -> 600 in 2m.
ryan: p95 improving?
omar: p95 down from 420ms -> 210ms over last 3m, p99 from 1.8s -> 700ms. streaming stall rate down 65%.
maria: good. customers complaints also decreasing. Support notified. Need to coordinate handoff in 30m for deeper remediation.
kevin: post-mitigation next steps: - run slab defrag tool on affected hosts (non-disruptive if we throttle) - increase slab size for hot keys via config - add proactive hot-shard rebalancer - telemetry: add prefill/decode queue ratios to alerting so we get early warning
ryan: agree. I'll document on incident page and create follow-ups. For now we keep prefill disabled and reweight active. Any objections to a rolling restart after slab defrag?
omar: prefer to avoid restarts; try slab defrag + warmup first. schedule restarts only if p99 doesn't settle to <600ms in 20m.
jess: creating follow-up tasks. `task:INC-6142` created for slab defrag and rebalancer work.
infra-bot: MONITOR: p95=210ms p99=690ms prefill_queue=180 decode_queue=320 page_faults=420.
ryan: good progress. I'll hand off to maria for the 30m on-call. maria, you're primary for remediation and postmortem. I'll remain reachable for escalation.
maria: taking over. summary for handoff: prefill-induced fragmentation caused eviction storms and page-ins on shards 23/24. Immediate mitigations: disabled prefill for redwood-13b, reweight traffic, monitor. Next: slab defrag, slab size tuning, rebalancer and improved alerting.
ryan: thanks — marking this incident as active->mitigated. Keep thread updated with any regressions. :thumbsup:
